'''Stuart Caldwell''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2001 Melbourne Sealed Deck tournament (16 September)]] on 16 September 2001 with Hyperdrive deck, according to Rodney Lee's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2975">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-melbourne-australia-16-09-2001d2975/ melbourne-australia-16-09-2001], DeckTech (Rodney "DS Pro" Lee, 17 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-melbourne-australia-16-09-2001d2975/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
